title: Bolu Learns to Put Things Back
moral: Putting things back keeps your space safe and organized.

scenes.summary: Bolu the bear enjoys playing but never puts his things back.
scenes.text:
Bolu the Bear Who Didn’t Put Things Back

In a cozy forest cabin, lived a friendly bear named Bolu.

Bolu loved playing with his toys.

Blocks, balls, and little carts—he had many!

But there was one problem…

Bolu never put things back.
scenes.image_prompt: cute bear playing with toys in cozy cabin, colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Bolu leaves toys everywhere despite being told to clean up.
scenes.text:
After playing, Bolu left toys everywhere.

Blocks on the floor…

Balls under the table…

Carts near the door…

“Bolu, clean up!” said Ria the Rabbit.

“I’ll do it later,” Bolu said.
scenes.image_prompt: messy room with toys scattered and rabbit reminding bear, cartoon style

scenes.summary: The mess grows and Bolu cannot find his favorite toy.
scenes.text:
Day by day, the mess grew.

Soon, Bolu couldn’t find his favorite ball.

“Where is it?” he wondered.

He searched and searched.

But it was lost.
scenes.image_prompt: bear searching for toy in messy room looking confused, cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: Bolu trips over a toy and realizes the problem.
scenes.text:
One day, Bolu walked quickly—

Oops!

He tripped over a toy.

“Ahh!” he cried.

That hurt!

Ria came over.

“Let’s clean together,” she said.

They picked up the toys…

Sorted the blocks…

And put everything back.
scenes.image_prompt: bear tripping over toy then cleaning with rabbit, friendly cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Bolu learns to keep his space tidy and enjoys the benefits.
scenes.text:
Soon, the room looked neat and tidy.

Bolu found his ball easily.

“This is so nice!” he said.

From that day on, Bolu put things back after playing.

And he never tripped again!

Putting things back keeps your space safe and clean.

Good habits make life easier.

The End
